name: CommandMessage
summary: Carries an instruction to do something, so that invoking a procedure in another application is a message rather than a call.

roles.name: CommandMessage
roles.summary: A message whose content is an imperative — cancel this booking, print this document. It expects one handler and, usually, a reply saying what happened; naming it as a command is what tells a reader that ignoring it is a defect rather than a choice.
